notes.voiceConvention: International English, sensei cadence (short sentences, present tense, observation-then-pause). Each NPC keeps a distinct register: Sensei Wren warm-patient, The Lender smooth-trickster, Kai at the Cart brief-vendor, Mara of the Corner Shop no-nonsense numbers-first, Arlo impulsive-young-friend, Lia the Courier terse systems-thinker, Master Tobias elder-wisdom slow, Mom (on the line) worried-mother, The Postman terse fragments, Biscuit non-verbal action tokens.
notes.roleConvention: Chamber 1 (the First Dojo, budgeting) frames money as attention, not optimisation. Sensei Wren is the mentor (PRD §5). The Lender is the cautionary foil. Arlo is the same-age peer foil (impulsive). Kai, Mara, Lia, Tobias are ambient adults each modelling a different relationship to money (information, discipline, systems, patience). Ma on the line is the off-screen anchor. The Postman gates weekly content. Biscuit is the affection sub-system.
notes.diversityNote: Cast spans the very young (Biscuit narratively) to the very old (Master Tobias, 70+). Gender balance: five women (Sensei Wren, Mara, Lia, Ma; Biscuit gender-neutral), four men (The Lender, Kai, Master Tobias, The Postman), one same-age peer (Arlo). The setting is implicitly South-Asian in the art; the writing register is international English. No caste or religion markers — deliberately omitted.
notes.scheduleConvention: All blocks in 24h in-game time, covering 06:00-22:00 active window. NPCs off-screen outside their blocks are assumed asleep or off-route. Indoor locations (mayas-room, aaravs-room, dipus-room, kirana-shop, chai-stall) are exclusive to one NPC. Suffix '-exterior' (e.g. chai-stall-exterior, kirana-shop-exterior) marks the public threshold where overlap is permitted. Outdoor locations (courtyard, alley, rooftop, building-entrance, street, dabbawala-route) allow free overlap and are encouraged to feel populated. 'phone-line' is a non-spatial channel routed through the player's room landline.
notes.memoryConvention: Hooks reference codebase state keys: wallets.inrCash (wallets_inr_*), masteryNodes (mastery_node_gte:<nodeId>:<level>), questsState (completed_quest:<id>, active_quest:<id>, failed_quest:<id>:<count>), streaks.currentLen (streak_current_gte:<n>). NPC-specific keys (tab_balance, pet_count, fed_biscuit_streak, missed_repayment) are local sub-system state owned by the NPC's authored quest chain. <<requires_district_unlock:*>> guards gate dialog branches behind district progression so NPCs don't spoil future content.
notes.districtUnlockGate: Budget Mastery I unlocks Bank Bazaar (PRD §5 table). Wren, Lia, and Tobias each have a graduation branch under <<requires_district_unlock:bank-bazaar>>. Bhola and Tobias hint at later districts (Bank Bazaar, Bhavishya Ghat) but never deliver content beyond Chawl Mohalla scope.
